NEW SECTION . 321.175 Human trafficking 4 prevention training —— commercial drivers. 5 1. An applicant for the initial issuance of a class A, 6 B, or C commercial driver’s license must certify to the 7 department that the applicant successfully completed a course 8 of instruction regarding human trafficking prevention. 9 2. A course of instruction regarding human trafficking 10 prevention must last at least thirty minutes and include 11 training based on the department’s approved human trafficking 12 prevention training materials. The course must be offered in 13 the English language. 14 3. The department shall approve, in cooperation with the 15 department of education and the state board of education, 16 human trafficking prevention training materials regarding the 17 recognition, prevention, and reporting of human trafficking. 18 The departments may collaborate with other entities that 19 specialize in and produce training materials regarding the 20 recognition, prevention, and reporting of human trafficking 21 particularly for persons who operate commercial motor vehicles. 22 The departments shall make the approved human trafficking 23 prevention training materials available to the public. The 24 departments shall review and update the departments’ approved 25 human trafficking prevention training materials to account for 26 changes and trends in human trafficking at least once every 27 three years. 28 4. The department may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 17A to 29 administer this section. 30 Sec. 2.
